# dsh-intent-recognition
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: five-layer intent recognition pipeline + scenario/intent management
UI + dual-edition storage (basic = zero-config local file, advanced = PostgreSQL + pgvector) + dist
ributable API services + DSH-native routing (agent tools / workflows / subagents / Cordis services).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Every layer can be toggled off per service** — disabled layers are skipped entirely.
## Control plane + data plane
- **Control plane (management UI)**: the **Intent Recognition** sidebar panel (same level as the Plu
gins entry; pin/unpin from the sidebar's More menu), plus a Settings → Intent Recognition section —

both render the same management UI. Tooling only; it never joins the conversation.
- **Data plane (c
onsumable services)**: a running service can be consumed two ways:
| Channel | Notes | Best for |
| **Agent tool** (recommended) | each running service registers `intent_recognize_<service-slug>`; h

igh-confidence hits execute the route inside the tool | DSH main agent routing user turns |
| **Cord
is service** | `ctx.intentRecognition.predict(service, query, context)` for other plugins | programm
x.intentRecognition.predict(service, query, context)` for other plugins | programmatic integration |
## Features
- **Zero-config start**: the basic edition (local file storage) is the default — install and build i
ntents, models and services without any database. Upgrade to the advanced edition in-page whenever y

ou need vector retrieval; existing data migrates automatically.
- **Intent management**: per-scenari
o intent catalog (name/code/description/examples/keywords/blacklist/whitelist/route config), Excel i

mport (merge/replace) & export, one-click embedding rebuild (advanced).
- **Model configuration**: e
mbedding, Jev, fine-tuned and LLM models are all page-configured (OpenAI-compatible or plain http JS

ON endpoints), with connectivity tests.
- **Service management**: per-scenario API services, indepen
dent switches & parameters per layer, services can **run / stop / delete / copy**; per-service API k

eys; built-in test console and call logs.
- **Vector lab** (advanced): a dedicated tab for layer-2 r
ecall debugging — recall tests (type a question, see per-chunk scores and the aggregated intent cand
idate set, optionally inheriting a service's threshold/TopK), chunk browsing (example text / dims /
building model / timestamp, with single-chunk delete), and per-scenario coverage overview with in-pl

ace rebuild.
- **Route execution**: per-intent routes (none / DSH workflow / subagent / Cordis servi

ce) with a per-service `route_mode` (auto vs suggest).
- **Dual-edition storage**: basic = local JSO
N file (zero dependencies); advanced = PostgreSQL + pgvector (vectors and business data in one datab

ase), with in-page upgrade/downgrade.
- **Agent integration**: running services register/revoke `int
ent_recognize_<slug>` tools automatically; optionally contributes a system-prompt section listing av
ailable intent services.
Tabs follow the order of use: **Intents → Models → Services → Vector (advanced) → Database**. Until
the first service exists, a three-step onboarding strip sits on top of the page; in the basic editio
n the Vector tab carries a 🔒 and opens an upgrade explainer.

## Install
Prerequisites: Node.js ≥ 20, DSH installed (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`). **No database needed** — t
he basic edition works out of the box.
### Option A: dsh-market plugin marketplace (recommended)
Sidebar **Plugins Marketplace** → search `dsh-intent-recognition` → **Install**; reload the page whe
n prompted and the **Intent Recognition** entry appears in the sidebar:
| Marketplace install | Installed (sidebar entry) |
### Option B: npm registry / local package
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The desktop install flow from the official npm registry (Plugins → Add plugin → enter `dsh-intent-re
cognition`, source = npm official registry):
| Add plugin | Installing | Installed (running) |
> **When to switch editions**: start with the basic edition; upgrade on the Database tab when you ne
ed L2 vector retrieval. The switch is instant, local data migrates with ids and API keys preserved,
and you can switch back to basic at any time — the local file stays untouched.
> **Desktop note**: if the sidebar entry is missing after install/upgrade, reload the page first (Ct
rl+R or restart the app). The page loads the plugin client roster once at boot — the official plugin
manager shows the same "refresh" prompt after installs. If the entry is still missing after a reloa
d, check Settings → Intent Recognition: both come from the same client bundle, and if neither render
s the client half never loaded — confirm the component shows "running" on the plugin detail page.
[该节后续省略]
### Plugging downstream capabilities into DSH
The whole system treats DSH as the backbone — intent routing and downstream agents/workflows all att
m treats DSH as the backbone — intent routing and downstream agents/workflows all attach as plugins:
1. **Workflows**: scripts live in the intent's route config and travel with the catalog via Excel im

port/export ("workflow script" column). Reuse capabilities via `agent()` or route type `service`.
2.
**Subagents**: ship downstream capabilities as **agent preset** plugins (see `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agen

t-preset`); put the preset id in the route target.
3. **Cordis services**: a downstream plugin does
`ctx.reflect.provide('xxxService', ...)` in `apply`; set the route target to `xxxService.methodName`
. The method is called as `(result, exec)` where `result` carries query/intent/confidence/slots.
